title: Check-In, Collection and Incomplete Collections — Specimen Collection Appointments Standard
content:
Phlebotomy services standard for **Specimen Collection Appointments**: how a visit moves from booked to checked in, and from checked in to collected or incomplete.

## Check-in

Check-in is recorded when the patient arrives at the Patient Service Center within the arrival grace period, or when the phlebotomist reaches the home or facility and the patient is present.

## Fasting statement

When a test on the order needs fasting, the patient states at check-in whether they fasted for the required hours. A patient who has not fasted is not drawn, and the visit is recorded incomplete with the reason "not fasting".

## Incomplete collections

| Circumstance | Visit recorded | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| The visit type's number of venipuncture attempts has been made without success | Incomplete | Unsuccessful venipuncture |
| A timed collection is abandoned while the visit type requires the patient to remain on site | Incomplete | Patient left before collection |
| The order is on hold, cancelled or past its requisition validity at check-in | Incomplete | Missing valid order |
| The patient has not fasted for a test that needs fasting | Incomplete | Not fasting |

An incomplete visit is not a no-show and assesses nothing where the visit type waives fees on the visit rebooked after an incomplete collection. The patient rebooks, with a slot guaranteed within the visit type's rebooking priority figure in calendar days when that figure is above 0.

## Collection

A collected visit sends the specimen to the laboratory, where the order is accessioned under the rules of Laboratory Test Orders.

## Other provisions

- A self-collected urine specimen may be dropped off without a draw only where the visit type allows specimen drop-off.
- The lobby wait target is a service goal and never earns a fee credit.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection patient who leaves before the timed draws are finished: the visit is recorded incomplete, reason patient left before collection; with fees waived on the rebooked visit, nothing is assessed and the rebooked slot is guaranteed within 7 calendar days.
- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit where the phlebotomist arrives and the patient is present: check-in is recorded.
- A Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit with a wait longer than its lobby wait target: no fee credit arises.
